Explore this 78.7± acre ranch for sale in McLennan County, Texas, offering an excellent combination of recreational amenities, agricultural potential, and a convenient Central Texas location. With scenic ponds, road frontage, and established improvements, this property is ideal for a weekend retreat, hunting getaway, or working ranch.

The ranch features two ponds, approximately 1,000 feet of road frontage, an established shooting range, and a hay barn, providing everything you need to enjoy the outdoors while supporting livestock or hay production. Whether you're looking for a Texas ranch for sale, McLennan County acreage, or a versatile recreational property, this ranch is ready to enjoy.

• Two Scenic Ponds

• Ideal for Recreation, Ranching, or a Future Homesite
• Convenient Central Texas Location
